name: Hemlock Woolly Adelgid
desc: Hemlock Woolly Adelgid (Adelges tsugae): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 22 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Adelges tsugae, the hemlock woolly adelgid () or HWA, is an insect of the order Hemiptera (true bugs) native to East Asia. It feeds by sucking sap from hemlock and spruce trees.
